The '''''Diamond & Pearl'' arc''' (Japanese: '''ダイヤモンド・パール編''' ''Diamond & Pearl arc''), also referred to as '''''The Seventh Chapter''''' (Japanese: '''第七章''' ''The Seventh Chapter''), is the seventh story arc of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}, consisting of nine volumes. It is the third longest completed arc of the series. In North America, this arc is grouped with the {{MangaArc|Platinum}} as the eleven-volume ''Pokémon Adventures Diamond, Pearl, and Platinum'', as ''[[Pokémon Platinum Version]]'' had been released internationally by the time these two arcs were released internationally. It began serialization in November 2006, and ended in February 2010.

The arc follows the adventures of {{adv|Diamond}}, {{adv|Pearl}}, and {{adv|Platinum}}. Platinum, the daughter of the wealthy [[House of Berlitz|Berlitz family]], sets out to fulfill a family tradition of assembling a copy of her family's crest for herself at the summit of [[Mount Coronet]]. However, a misunderstanding causes her [[Paka and Uji|bodyguards]] to be switched up with Diamond and Pearl, an aspiring {{wp|manzai}} comedy duo, and together, they set off on a {{pkmn|journey}} through [[Sinnoh]]. During their travels, Platinum becomes interested in [[Pokémon battle]]s and sets out to defeat all of Sinnoh's [[Gym Leader]]s. The trio's journey is hindered by the actions of [[Team Galactic]], an [[Villainous team|evil organization]] with a plan that does not tolerate the young children getting in their way.

==Important events==
{{spoilers}}
{{main|Timeline of events in Pokémon Adventures#Diamond & Pearl arc|Timeline of events in the Diamond & Pearl arc of Pokémon Adventures}}
*{{adv|Diamond}} and {{adv|Pearl}} meet {{adv|Platinum}} through a coincidence and the three receive their first partner Pokémon.
*The trio stumble upon [[Cyrus]] at Mount Coronet.
*[[Paka and Uji]] are transported into [[Distortion World|another universe]] by [[Saturn]].
*Cyrus invades the ruins in [[Celestic Town]].
*Platinum finds out that Diamond and Pearl are not her real bodyguards.
*Platinum forgives her travelling companions, and the trio decide to split, with each member going to a different lake in the Sinnoh region.
*Team Galactic detonates the Galactic Bomb over Lake Valor. They capture the [[Lake guardians]].
*Cyrus crafts two [[Red Chain]]s.
*Diamond, Pearl, and Platinum reunite and set the Lake guardians free.
*Diamond, Pearl, and Platinum defeat Team Galactic and calm {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}}.
*{{p|Giratina|A shadow}} emerges and drags Cyrus, Dialga and Palkia inside a portal that appeared over the [[Spear Pillar]].
